Wieviele Zigaretten hat Helmut Schmidt an einem Tag geraucht? Seb and Irene act in a film about a racist murder as an actor. Seb embodies the murderer while Irene is a policewoman. Both actors are extremely talented and always remain in their roles without even breaking out of their characters for a moment.
Irene asks: "Why did you kill Angela Merkel?"
